articles.title: NCLT rejects Reliance Infra subsidiary's resolution plan
articles.description: The Mumbai bench of the NCLT rejected the resolution plan for SU Toll Road Pvt Ltd due to financial concerns. Furthermore, it specified that inviting fresh bids would extend the resolution process by an additional 120 days.
